title: LatE7/LonE7 signed 32-bit encoding
close_reason: Already fixed: signed 32-bit encoding is correctly implemented in all three codebases - Python uses struct '>ii', Rust uses i32::from_be_bytes(), C uses int32_t with proper signed range validation. Test vectors include negative coordinates (Seattle -122.3321 = -1223321000, min bounds -90/-180 = -900000000/-1800000000). All 71 Python coord tests pass.
